channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: What to watch this week: Hockey battles, wrestling section tournaments highlight busy schedule
item.description: On Strib Varsity this week: Don’t miss Minnetonka vs. Rogers boys hockey, Benilde-St. Margaret’s vs. Waconia girls basketball or any section tournament action as teams vie to advance to state.

item.title: The latest: Minnesotans win silver in mixed doubles curling; Paula Moltzan earns bronze at Winter Olympics
item.description: Moltzan of Prior Lake finished third in team combined in Alpine skiing, and Korey Dropkin and Cory Thiesse of Duluth lost a heartbreaker to Sweden in curling at the Milan Cortina Games.

item.title: State worker union investigating former president over claims of long work weeks, high pay
item.description: Between two jobs, former MAPE President Megan Dayton earned about $180,000 annually in recent years — far more than her predecessor.

item.title: University of Minnesota med school changes class after accusations of UnitedHealth ‘propaganda’
item.description: The school is changing an elective course while still working with the Eden Prairie-based health care giant after students raised concerns.

item.title: ‘No reason he should have died’: Alex Pretti’s parents open up
item.description: In their first sit-down interview, Michael and Susan Pretti avoided recriminations and recalled the son whom Michael called “an exceptionally kind, caring man.”

item.title: Prosecutors say Twin Cities man bought mansion thanks to $350M fraud scheme that netted $19M
item.description: Through his company, Caesar Wilson bought a lakeside estate in Prior Lake, according to prosecutors.

item.title: Federal agents make a chaotic arrest at downtown Minneapolis courthouse amid swarm of lawyers, observers
item.description: An 18-year-old, who was in court on charges of first-degree drug possession, was tackled and detained after a foot chase through the lobby of the Hennepin County Government Center.

item.title: Former federal prosecutor Joe Thompson joins Don Lemon’s defense team in church protest case
item.description: Longtime fraud prosecutor Joe Thompson joined Lemon’s defense nearly a month after leaving the U.S. Attorney’s Office that brought the charges.

item.title: The latest: Walz expects ICE surge will soon wind down in Minnesota
item.description: Gov. Tim Walz and Minneapolis Mayor Jacob Frey said they were both told by White House officials that a drawdown of federal agents was imminent.

item.title: Immigration attorneys call out dirty conditions, ‘disarray and chaos’ at Whipple detention facility
item.description: Attorneys for the Advocates for Human Rights visited the Whipple Federal Building on Monday following a judge’s ruling.
